newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat April Europe car sales rise 23.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Fiat April Europe car sales rise 23.3 pct.

text.p: Italy's carmaker Fiat Auto saw new car sales in April rose 23.3 percent in April in an overall European car market that increased 9.2 percent in the same month, said an industrial source on Friday.

The group's European market share rose to 12.7 percent in April from 11.2 percent in April 1996 maintaining the group in second place in the European car market after German carmaker Volkswagen, the source added.

In the first four months of the year, Fiat Auto had a market share of 12.7 percent from 12 percent in the same period of 1996 with an increase of sales of six percent in a market that only rose 0.6 percent.
